b9c9732b46.so_what: Designers, manufacturers and launch applicants must follow these IS standards during design, testing and launch integration.

b07ddee5d0.brief: Governments of Gujarat and Tamil Nadu agreed with IN‑SPACe to establish Common Technical Facilities for space manufacturing and launch-vehicle systems.
b07ddee5d0.so_what: Binds Gujarat, Tamil Nadu and IN‑SPACe to develop shared space manufacturing and launch‑vehicle technical facilities.

a99addb818.brief: Projects additional SATCOM capacity demand over India for next five years: ~12–14 C‑band teleport, 24 HITS C‑band, 24–28 Ku DTH transponders; telecom ~2 Tbps consumer, ~400 Gbps backhaul.

a904764811.brief: Requires companies/LLPs to obtain ten‑year MIB permission (subject to net‑worth, FDI, board residency, clearances, fees and PBG) to uplink or downlink satellite TV channels in India from 9 Nov 2022.
a904764811.so_what: Companies/LLPs must apply on Broadcast Seva, meet net‑worth/FDI/residency criteria, pay fees and furnish PBG; binds broadcasters and teleports.

a701fcb32a.brief: Facilitates an IN-SPACe-organized delegation of Indian non-government space entities to attend the International Astronautical Congress (IAC) 2025 in Sydney, profiling participating companies and capabilities.

a53fa458c0.brief: Declares that the registrations of the listed multi-system operators (MSOs) are cancelled, surrendered or expired as of 31.05.2026.
a53fa458c0.so_what: Listed MSOs lose valid MSO registration and thus cannot lawfully operate as MSOs; binds the named entities.

a2e8605e49.brief: Requires all registered MSOs to furnish Conditional Access System and Subscriber Management System deployment details to DoT by 20 June 2025 via specified email addresses.
a2e8605e49.so_what: MSOs must email CAS/SMS name, version, model and deployment date to DoT addresses by 20.06.2025.

9c5354088d.brief: Establishes nodal officers at the Ministry and CBFC to receive rights‑holder complaints and notify intermediaries to disable access to internet links hosting pirated films.
9c5354088d.so_what: Intermediaries must disable access to notified pirated‑film links upon nodal‑officer notification; applies to copyright holders' complaints.

9aedde5a26.brief: Requests the Ministry of Home Affairs to introduce a Performer's (Group) Visa and integrate security and crowd approvals for live events into the Single Window Clearance system.
9aedde5a26.so_what: MHA must create group-performer visa and fold event security/crowd approvals into single-window clearance; obligation on MHA.

933803903d.brief: Lists registered multi‑system operators (MSOs) with their registration validity periods and contact details as of 31.05.2026.

9238c65990.brief: Invites EOIs from consulting agencies to provide advanced technology solutions for film accessibility for persons with hearing and visual impairment; submissions due 12-06-2023.
9238c65990.so_what: Consulting agencies must submit sealed EOIs by 18:00 on 12-06-2023 to CBFC.

900d358256.brief: Require broadcasters, teleport operators and news agencies to remit all Ministry payments from 1 January 2017 electronically via the Bharatkosh NTRP (no cheques/bank drafts accepted).
900d358256.so_what: Electronic payment of all MIB fees/processing fees by TV channels, teleport operators and news agencies.

8d34ceb5ab.brief: Requests Ministry of Tourism to examine and implement the enclosed Execution Framework for India's Live Entertainment Economy, using tourism funds to upgrade venues and incentivize destination-based events.
8d34ceb5ab.so_what: Requires Ministry of Tourism to act on the framework and allocate tourism funds for venue upgrades and event incentives.

8c1a5b887c.brief: Requires Local Cable Operators to register/renew online with the MIB via the Broadcast Seva Portal; registrations run five years and are valid throughout India, fee Rs5,000, renew 90 days prior.
8c1a5b887c.so_what: LCOs must apply/renew online, pay Rs5,000; MIB is the registering authority.

86ab38dfaa.brief: Designates the 67 listed satellite TV channels as 'Devotional/Spiritual/Yoga' for the purpose of temporary uplinking of live events.
86ab38dfaa.so_what: Listed channels may temporarily uplink live events subject to uplinking permissions; binds those channels and uplink service providers.

855c5760fa.brief: Prescribes account heads and codes for processing, permission, renewal, amendment fees, security deposits and late-payment interest for TV channels, teleports and news agencies.
855c5760fa.so_what: Requires these entities to use specified MIB account codes when paying those fees/deposits.

837ea6961f.brief: Requires satellite payload developers to adopt detailed QMS and specific design, qualification, testing and EMI/software controls — using representative qualification samples, connector controls, documented procedures and configuration control.
837ea6961f.so_what: Payload manufacturers/integrators must implement QMS, representative qualification testing, documented assembly/testing procedures, connector/EMI controls and configuration-managed software.

78a6fa3141.brief: Schedules Phase 3 standards (FRACA; launch-site, flight-safety, AIT, single-junction solar-cell calibration; contamination control) for development/implementation in 2026–27.

75fdfc597d.brief: Requires LCOs to obtain online central registration via Broadcast Seva Portal, valid across India for five years with Rs.5,000 processing fee, effective January 17, 2025.
75fdfc597d.so_what: Local Cable Operators must apply/renew online on Broadcast Seva, pay Rs.5,000, and renew at least 90 days before expiry.

7535d81b91.brief: Authorises IN‑SPACe to lead a delegation to promote selected Indian private space companies at Venice's Veneto Space Meetings in 2026.

7481a211f7.brief: Requires applicants for MSO and LCO registration/renewal to file exclusively via Broadcast Seva Portal and pay online fees: Rs.1,00,000 (MSO, 10 years); Rs.5,000 (LCO, 5 years).
7481a211f7.so_what: Applicants must use the portal and pay only prescribed online fee; third‑party 'consultant' charges prohibited.

7390379f2d.brief: Mandates integration of live-event clearances into the India Cine Hub single-window platform, to be implemented by the JWG for central and state-level clearances.
7390379f2d.so_what: Event organisers and central/state clearance agencies must use India Cine Hub single-window for live-event permissions.

6c6b95b348.brief: Requests States/UTs to immediately adopt the Model Executive Order (Model SOP) for Live Event Clearances through executive orders, per LEDC decision of 4 February 2026.
6c6b95b348.so_what: States/UTs must adopt the Model Order via executive orders and report adoption/implementation status to MIB.

69878fce80.brief: Requires existing satellite-TV permission-holders to increase net worth to 25% of the shortfall (2022 vs requirements as on 08.11.2022) by 31.12.2023, 75% by 30.09.2024, full by 31.12.2024.
69878fce80.so_what: Obliges existing satellite-TV permission-holders to meet staged net-worth increases (25%, 75%, full) by the dates.

644461d26e.brief: Reaffirms that satellite TV channel permission-holders may only provide TV signal decoders to registered MSOs/cable operators, registered DTH operators, authorized IPTV providers, and permitted HITS operators.
644461d26e.so_what: Satellite TV channel permission-holders must supply decoders only to listed entities (MSOs, DTH, authorized IPTV, HITS operators).

623bcf6960.brief: Requires the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports to develop and mandate operational frameworks allowing stadiums, arenas and sports facilities to be used for non-sporting events (15 July 2025).
623bcf6960.so_what: Obliges Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports to set and enforce rules for non-sporting use of public sports venues.

61d28b818c.brief: Publishes promotional DataWall company profiles of Indian space‑tech and adjacent startups for IN‑SPACe's Industry Connect event on 10–11 June 2026.

613c7bf72c.brief: Directs IN-SPACe to prioritise enabling NGEs to scale in 2026, including support for planned orbital launches, Phase II Technical Centre, private ground stations and communication satellites.
613c7bf72c.so_what: Requires IN-SPACe to support NGEs' launches, Technical Centre Phase II, and private ground/communication satellite development in 2026.

5d48e661ae.brief: IN-SPACe requires authorization to disseminate satellite remote-sensing data at ground sampling distance (GSD) ≤ 30 cm; data with GSD > 30 cm needs intimation to IN-SPACe.
5d48e661ae.so_what: NGEs and government entities must obtain IN-SPACe authorization for ≤30 cm GSD data; others must intimate.

5acb688b84.brief: Establishes a model Minor Degree in Space Technology requiring six courses (five compulsory, one optional) totaling 19–22 credits, with specified course codes and credit allocations.
5acb688b84.so_what: Institutions need not seek AICTE approval; students must complete listed courses and 19–22 credits to obtain the minor.

593e1e6b83.brief: Extended the cut-off date for ongoing contracts of non-Indian satellite capacity for SATCOM to 30 September 2025.
593e1e6b83.so_what: Binds SATCOM operators/licensees with non-Indian satellite capacity contracts to the 30 Sept 2025 deadline.

5856d723bc.brief: Designates the MIB Section Officer (digital addressable systems) as registering authority for LCOs and the MIB Additional/Joint Secretary as registering authority for MSOs, effective 17 January 2025.
5856d723bc.so_what: MIB officials must register LCOs and MSOs; binds MIB and all LCOs/MSOs seeking registration.

58357254c8.brief: Appoints Shri Govind Mishra (Sr. Administrative Officer, CBFC Mumbai) as Transparency Officer to ensure compliance with Section 4 proactive disclosure guidelines under the RTI Act, effective 06.07.2023.
58357254c8.so_what: Officer must implement Section 4 proactive disclosures, manage RTI records and disposal; binds CBFC including Mumbai and regional offices.

583235c709.brief: Makes available space for three Indian private operators to establish S/X/Ka ground stations at NRSC Shadnagar, offered on 10/20-year leases; EoI submissions due 25 June 2026.
583235c709.so_what: Indian private entities must submit EoI responses by 25 June 2026, 16:00 to be considered.

576c68ee2e.brief: Requires private satellite TV channels to provide 15 hours/month of public service broadcasting (PSB), counted monthly, effective 1 March 2023, with monthly reporting.
576c68ee2e.so_what: Private satellite broadcasters must air 15 hours/month PSB and file monthly reports on Broadcast Seva Portal.

4e453ea652.brief: Mandates QA programmes for Indian space projects across the lifecycle, requiring bidirectional traceability, Parts Control Board screening of EEE, dual-fault tolerance for critical systems, and Project‑Manager centralized risk ownership.
4e453ea652.so_what: Space project teams must implement QA programmes; PMs hold centralized risk responsibility; suppliers subject to parts control screening.

4ced7a79b1.brief: Operative substance of this IN-SPACe presentation was not readable in the provided extract, so I cannot state any requirement or decision.

4504be35c1.brief: Directs State/UT governments to nominate nodal officers, make public venues available for live entertainment, and integrate state-level event permissions into the India Cine Hub single-window portal.
4504be35c1.so_what: State/UTs must appoint nodal officers, enable venue use, and route event approvals via India Cine Hub.

44ffd66e26.brief: Permits FDI in space-sector activities: automatic up to 74% (most satellite, ground and user-segment activities), launch-related items automatic up to 49% with government route beyond; notify IN‑SPACe within 30 days.
44ffd66e26.so_what: Investee companies must notify IN‑SPACe within 30 days of receiving funds; government approval required above stated caps.

4372a9737e.brief: Mandates compliance with IS 18326:2023 (material, mechanical parts/processes) for all space-deliverable products across mission-definition, design, development, production, operations and disposal.
4372a9737e.so_what: Obliges space product suppliers and project teams to implement MMPP controls and traceability across all programme phases.

400f1e3a54.brief: Directs DPIIT to lead creation of a Centralised Digital Music Licensing Registry, engage copyright licensing bodies, and act on the enclosed execution framework for India's live entertainment sector.
400f1e3a54.so_what: DPIIT must establish a central digital music-licensing registry and coordinate with copyright licensing bodies.

33d7135fdf.brief: MIB cancelled/closed/rejected numerous MSO registration applications as of 31.05.2026, primarily for MHA security-clearance denial, applicant withdrawal, missing documents, negative net worth, non‑payment of Rs1 lakh.
33d7135fdf.so_what: MSO applicants must obtain MHA security clearance and timely submit required documents and processing fee; binds MSO applicants/registrants.

3314368079.brief: Proposes realization of additional high-resolution EO satellite constellations via private-sector participation to meet India's EO data demand, and invites stakeholder comments to IN-SPACe.

311a4733df.brief: Expanded the JWG for Live Events (Sept 2025) to add specified central Joint Secretaries, ACS/Prl. Secretaries from four states, and named industry bodies including BCCI and BookMyShow.
311a4733df.so_what: States, ministries, and listed bodies must nominate officials (not below Joint Secretary) to the JWG via the provided email.

2ff5ae095e.brief: Exempts sub-orbital launches with combined total impulse below 40,960 Ns from mandatory IN‑SPACe authorization, while advising 30‑day intimation to IN‑SPACe for launches >10,000 Ns.
2ff5ae095e.so_what: Operators of launches >10,000 Ns should notify IN‑SPACe 30 days prior; local authorities retain permitting responsibility.

2935914706.brief: Requires all private satellite TV channels to upload monthly PSB reports on the Broadcast Seva Portal by the 7th day of the following month.
2935914706.so_what: Monthly PSB reporting obligation binding all Ministry-permitted private satellite TV broadcasters.

23c456abe1.brief: Clarifies that 'Director' means Companies Act s2(34), requires all key managerial personnel and editorial staff be resident Indians, and limits Para 6(g) majority rule to News TV channels.
23c456abe1.so_what: News TV channel permit-holders must have all KMP and editorial staff resident Indians; board must have majority resident Indian directors.

2277fa1ecc.brief: Constitutes a Joint Working Group, chaired by Secretary, Ministry of I&B, with specified government and industry members, to implement the Live Event Industry framework and develop a single‑window clearance.
2277fa1ecc.so_what: Ministries, states and listed industry bodies must nominate officials to the JWG and email contact details.

2113e0da9b.brief: Invited Indian private industries to submit expressions of interest to receive transfer of ISRO’s Small Satellite Launch Vehicle (SSLV) technology via IN-SPACe.
2113e0da9b.so_what: Indian private firms may apply on IN-SPACe portal to be considered for SSLV technology transfer.

1bbe794f96.brief: Nominates Sayyid Rabeehashmi as Chief Information Security Officer and Govind Mishra as Deputy Chief Information Security Officer for CBFC Mumbai, effective 16.01.2024, until further orders.
1bbe794f96.so_what: CBFC Mumbai must recognize them as CISO and Dy. CISO; they assume the roles' responsibilities.

1403ed863e.brief: Requests the Ministry of Defence to onboard defence-related filming clearances onto the India Cine Hub portal for online processing of locations, equipment, personnel, aerial filming and content-sensitivity approvals.
1403ed863e.so_what: MoD must direct its departments to process defence filming permissions online via ICH; binds MoD officials.

0e6712be60.brief: Requires uplinking/downlinking Permission Holders to furnish an irrevocable, on-demand bank guarantee of Rs 1 crore per non-news channel and Rs 2 crore per news channel, valid initially two years.
0e6712be60.so_what: TV uplinking/downlinking Permission Holders must provide (and renew) the specified PBG amounts.

0b4a33e4c2.brief: Directs cable operators to carry the updated list of mandatory Doordarshan and Sansad TV channels, as modified by Notification S.O. 325(E) dated 17 January 2025.
0b4a33e4c2.so_what: Carry those mandatory channels in appropriate genre; binds all MSOs and LCOs.

0299e1d2bf.brief: Authorises Ananth Technologies Limited to develop and operate a GSO communications satellite and assigns the corresponding ITU filing to ATL.
0299e1d2bf.so_what: Allows ATL to deploy and commercially operate a GSO satellite; binds ATL under IN-SPACe authorization.

00b160406b.brief: Requires Authorisation from IN-SPACe for establishing or operating space-based or ground-based SSA sensors and for providing SSA services, with separate authorisations for each activity.
00b160406b.so_what: Indian entities must obtain separate IN-SPACe permits; hobbyist/academic exemptions apply subject to thresholds.
